facts.fact: The DBE's EMIS Directorate, with NECT, held user acceptance testing on 2-4 February 2026 of the modernised SA-SAMS, a cloud-based system to strengthen data management across public schools nationally, ahead of a phased primary-school pilot and national rollout.

facts.fact: The Minister of Basic Education's written reply says the DBE's LURITS holds data at individual learner level with ID numbers, and that LURITS data for 2020 to 2025 covering about 10.3 million public-school learners in Grades 1-11 was linked across years.

facts.fact: The SA-SAMS Project Team, for the Department of Basic Education, is modernising SA-SAMS on UNESCO's OpenEMIS, with requirements completed in 2022-2023, curriculum management under way and a pilot in about 10% of schools planned from September 2024.
